description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the toolbar module, including help text, page top modifications, and toolbar item definitions.

classes.name: ToolbarHooks
classes.description: Class implementing Drupal hooks for the toolbar module, including help display, page top modifications, and toolbar item definitions.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information about the toolbar module for a specific route.

methods.name: pageTop
methods.description: Adds the toolbar to the top of the page if the user has permission.

methods.name: toolbar
methods.description: Defines the toolbar items, including 'Back to site' and 'Manage' links, and manages subtrees hash for dynamic loading.
